required_findings.reason: Project video_probe measured native 768x1344, 24 fps, 124 frames and one AAC 32 kHz stereo stream.
Project video_review measured approximately 5.0 seconds of speech in the 5.167-second clip.

Independent small and medium Chinese ASR both recovered the full spoken phonetic sequence for 出门前用青颜，抑汗净味，清爽舒适. The orthographic alternatives 青言/清盐 and 意汗/意旱 are homophones; medium ASR closed 净味 and 清爽舒适. Exact written characters remain owned by the burned caption, not inferred from audio orthography alone.
Dense visual contact frames show the single on-screen main woman looking toward camera with continuous speaking mouth shapes and no second visible speaker.
Face, hair ornament, earrings, embroidered ivory blouse and navy skirt remain stable across the sampled sequence.
The hand-held capped cylindrical bottle keeps a stable yellow label and white cap; readable label truth remains delegated to the source packshot in Composition.
Exactly two hands remain attached to the main woman; the bottle lift is continuous and no extra arm enters the frame.
Mouth, head, bottle hand and free hand show continuous motion. FFmpeg freezedetect found only the initial 0.25-second settle and no later freeze interval.
Project review measured one scene; dense frames show one locked-camera take with no internal cut, pose reset or scale jump.
